description: This file defines the Cart controller class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, handling cart display, product management, and removal functionalities within the catalog module.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Controller class for managing shopping cart operations in the OpenCart catalog module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the shopping cart view, including products, totals, and links.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Outputs the cart view within an AJAX or similar request.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart based on the provided key and returns a JSON response.
